glossary.role: Drake Luft's flagship aura battleship; an enemy ship in Operation 25.
Aura battleship of Queen Ciela Lapana (Kingdom of Na)
Anti-Orphan battleship (carrier with a pyramid superstructure); base of the Brain Powerd pilots
Only appears as オーラノヴァ砲, the main cannon of the aura battleship Goraon.
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
Aura battleship of Elle Humm (Kingdom of Lao), armed with the Aura Nova Cannon
Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness

glossary.role: Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: Queen of the Kingdom of Na; commands the aura battleship Gran-Garan; gives Sho the Billbine
glossary.personality: Serene, dignified young queen with strong Aura Power and a sense of duty to all of Byston Well. Calm but resolute.

glossary.role: Masked identity of Burn Bunnings, Drake's former commander, after Sho defeats him; Sho's rival; pilots Zwarth and Galava in ACE2
glossary.personality: Once proud and respected, now bitter and obsessed with revenge on Sho. Cold, theatrical, and hides his face behind a mask.

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op25_06. Covers the climax of the battle against Drake's Will Wips and Burn Bunnings (strictly referred to as Black Knight where Japanese uses 黒騎士), Queen Ciela's regal resolve to sacrifice the Gran-Garan to shatter Will Wips's Aura barrier, and Hime's moving persuasion of Orphan treating it as an individual with a heart and offering Yuu to comfort it.
